events.title: US Inflation Rate
events.summary: The US inflation rate has been rising, with the latest data showing a 3-year high. The Federal Reserve has indicated that it will keep interest rates steady for now, but may hike rates later in the year if inflation continues to rise.
events.reasoning: Rising inflation could lead to higher interest rates, which would negatively impact long-term bonds. On the other hand, TIPS bonds could benefit from rising inflation as they offer protection against inflation.

timeFrame.note: Monitor inflation data and Fed decisions closely

events.exitStrategy: Exit positions if inflation data comes in lower than expected or if the Fed indicates a dovish stance
